regulation_clause.text: If a credit card is not activated within 30 days of issuance, the issuer must seek OTP-based consent; absent consent, the account must be closed without cost within 7 working days of seeking confirmation.

finding.rationale: The clause requires closure without cost within seven working days when consent is absent. In 2000-DECIDE, closure is selected only when WS-CONSENT-DAYS > 7; at seven the code selects SEEKOTP, exceeding the stated closure window.

trajectory.final_answer: The rule requires closure within seven working days when consent is absent. The code selects CLOSE only when WS-CONSENT-DAYS is greater than 7, so at seven days it still selects SEEKOTP.
